description: Objective for a NONLINEAR steam-heated exchanger: hold outlet temperature in spec while minimizing steam-valve opening (energy). The equal-percentage valve makes dCV/dMV vary ~2.5x across the operating band, so the WM must learn the LOCAL gain (a single identified gain is wrong). Violation/move weights auto-derived from cv_priority + identified dynamics. HIGH-side temperature limit 2.5x more urgent than LOW-side via cv_side_scale.
